Diluted FFO before adjustments = 214,266. Software transition costs are printed as '-' for the quarter and recorded as 0. Net (gain)/loss on consolidation classified as nareit_other. Company reports no AFFO metric; the AFFO fields are null. No recurring capex disclosure appears on the supplied pages. Per-share check: 214,266/346,034 = 0.62; 224,773/346,034 = 0.65. Amounts are in thousands; share count is printed in thousands.
